card.name: Adjectives in lists before more adjectives
card.fires_on: Adjectives ending in -ic, -al or -ly (such as intellectually, literary, scientific, spiritual, natriuretic) when they sit in a series of descriptive words, or partway through one. Another adjective or noun often follows.

card.writes: It seems to favor word endings like -ized, -ity and -gia, and to push away unrelated name and suffix pieces.
card.plain: It fires on descriptive words like literary, scientific or natriuretic, especially when several are listed together.
